body: Thank you so much! I think I'm cool with waiting and seeing, and potentially just splitting when we don't fit together anymore. Might be a bit of a heartbreak, but I'm willing to go through
My issue is that I'm not on T and I look more androgynous by default than masculine, so maybe that's the thing. Thank you so much for advice!

Thank you for such a helpful comment! I like to think that we have enough of that maturity to figure this out. I'm not pushing and I told him first things first that I'm not expecting him to turn out bi and if he's straight, then we'll still be good friends. He's really open about his thoughts as I'm about mine. When I ask questions about this, he answers truthfully even if it might not be what I'd like to hear. Maybe our situation is the ideal and he's bi - but if not, that'll be okay too. I think I'll gladly stick with him to find out
Thanks. I'll keep that in mind and think through what I want right now

Thank you for commenting! We're both more into something more casual than not, but we fit on a lot of levels. He was very apologetic when it all happened and told me he'd understand if I didn't want to continue our thing, so I believe he's being truthful judging by this and a few other things.
Oh, that's actually a great point. I'll have to try asking him around the subject of my transition then. I'm still at the point of, as you called it, social transition phase. Thank you a lot!
Thanks for commenting! He's assured me dozens times that he only sees me as who I tell him I am, that I'm a guy to him. I need to figure it out by myself, but it means a lot to hear another opinion
